title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: analyzing complex workflows, data scientists frequently work multiple related tables simultaneously: clinical demographics, longitudinal vitals, lab panels, crosswalk dictionaries, summary reports. Existing tools force analysts siloed, tabbed interfaces one table visible time. Switching back forth tabs breaks cognitive flow, obscures structural discrepancies, makes mental reconciliation column mappings error-prone. sideview replaces tabbed viewers hardware-accelerated 2D infinite canvas. can place number heterogeneous tabular datasets side--side, zoom pan freely across workspace, visually connect columns across tables interactive SVG splines, sort filter columns directly table headers, automatically detect categorical discrepancies, generate idiomatic tidyverse code pastes directly active RStudio script editor.
code: library(sideview)  # Launch side-by-side multi-table canvas in RStudio Viewer or Gadget Window sideview(patients, visits, lab_results, gt_summary)

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: sideview built Dual-Hybrid Architecture: Bi-directional reactive communication JavaScript Panzoom canvas R session. Live column mapping, interactive sorting, filter popovers, discrepancy detection, AI prompting. Code delivery user’s active editor buffer via rstudioapi::insertText(), execution console upon exit via stopApp(), immediate evaluation .GlobalEnv. Self-contained, zero-dependency HTML bundles embeddable reports, Quarto presentations, shared offline stakeholders.
code: flowchart TD     subgraph Ingestion ["Universal Normalization Engine"]         DF["data.frame / tibble"] --> NORM["sv_normalize()"]         TAB["table / matrix"] --> NORM         GT["gt / gtsummary"] --> NORM         FLEX["flextable"] --> NORM         WID["htmlwidgets"] --> NORM     end      subgraph Core ["sideview Cards & State"]         NORM --> CARDS["sideview_card Objects (Grid / HTML / Widget)"]     end      subgraph Gadget ["Interactive Mode: sideview()"]         CARDS --> GADGET["Shiny Gadget (Canvas + Panzoom)"]         GADGET --> MAP["Interactive SVG Field Mapping"]         GADGET --> SORT["Header Sort & Filter Popovers"]         GADGET --> DISC["Discrepancy & Recode Engine"]         GADGET --> LLM["LLM Code Generator (Ollama / OpenAI)"]         LLM --> RSTUDIO["rstudioapi: Insert to Active Script / Console"]         MAP --> RSTUDIO         SORT --> RSTUDIO         DISC --> RSTUDIO     end      subgraph Widget ["Export Mode: save_sideview()"]         CARDS --> HTMLWID["htmlwidget Container"]         HTMLWID --> HTML["Standalone Self-Contained HTML File"]         HTMLWID --> QMD["Quarto (.qmd) / R Markdown (.Rmd)"]     end

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: Action Drawer provides 4 dedicated execution actions plus clearing controls: - Insert Script: Pastes code directly active .R document cursor position (runs independently without interrupting gadget). - Run & Exit: Sends code R console immediately closes gadget, triggering instant execution RStudio. - Run R: Evaluates code directly inside current R session environment (.GlobalEnv) keeping canvas open, accompanied status toast showing output dimensions. - Run Console: Queues code RStudio console buffer (executes upon closing gadget). - Clear Button: Instantly clears connector splines, active filters, sort orders, resets code block. - [✓] Auto-clear Toggle: enabled, automatically clears operations whenever click Insert Script Copy.

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: sideview seamlessly accepts heterogeneous R tabular structures single call: - data.frame & tibble: Virtualized interactive grid cards. - base::table & matrix: Automatically converted 2D frequency/matrix grid cards. - gt & gtsummary: Rendered raw HTML styling, preserving underlying data frame (gt_tbl$_data) full code generation. - **flextable**: Rendered full styling, retaining underlying dataset joins mutations. - **htmlwidgets** (DT,reactable`, etc.): Visual embedded cards side--side comparison.

title: sideview: Multi-Table 2D Infinite Canvas for R
text: Cross-table discrepancy analysis (sv_detect_discrepancies()): Identifies exact matches, unique categories Table , unique categories Table B. Uses vectorized Levenshtein distance calculations spot fuzzy typos (e.g., "M" vs "Male", "Compl." vs "Completed"). Emits reproducible recoding pipelines using dplyr::case_match forcats::fct_recode:
code: patients <- patients %>%   dplyr::mutate(status = dplyr::case_match(     status_raw,     c("Compl.", "completed") ~ "Completed",     "InProg" ~ "In Progress",     .default = status_raw   ))
